Folio — the curated theme set

Home regenerated per theme from the six swatches each face authors. Nine families × two separately painted faces = eighteen faces, no two of which share a palette.

Applied in this build: the plate's three hues are now chosen for separation instead of list order — abyss's dark face went from 183/195/290 (13° apart) to 183/290/34 (104° apart); the renderer draws the plate in all three hues rather than one; the crown is an authored band with the name reversed out of it; the dark floor deepened 0.32 → 0.50 and the light face gained a lift at the top and a deeper floor; and the hero pane on a dark face went 0.46 → 0.62 so the card reads brighter than the near-black room.

build marker: masthead — if you cannot see the wordmark in colour on the Home sheets, you are looking at a cached copy.
